message.content: Based on the conversation, LiHua finds several aspects of Black Myth: Wukong immersive. Specifically, she mentions enjoying the exploration aspect, finding it fun to discover new areas and secrets within the game. Additionally, she highlights the combat style as being particularly engaging, noting that it blends well with the storyline and feels very immersive. LiHua expresses her enjoyment of the game's fluid gameplay and the way it immerses her in the narrative and world.
